name: Mickey Mouse
text:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
FAIR TRADE Once during the Illumineers' turn, an Illumineer may pay 3 lore. If they do, each Illumineer draws a card.

name: Rapunzel
text:
IRON DEFENSE During the Vine's turn, this character gains Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
KA-BONK! Once during the Illumineers' turn, an Illumineer may pay 2 lore to deal 1 damage to chosen Vineling character. This damage can't be reduced by Resist.

name: Chamber Guardian
text:
Ward
MALEVOLENT GROWTH When the Vine plays this character, make a Vine Tendril for each Illumineer and move the Vine's draw token up 1.
TRIUMPH When this character is banished, the Illumineers win the scenario and open The Search for Piglet prize pack!

name: Sulley
text:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)
GET BACK OUT THERE Whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, an Illumineer may pay 1 lore to ready him.

name: Maleficent
text:
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character gets +3 {S}.) 
MYSTICAL VISION Once during the Illumineers' turn, an Illumineer may pay 2 lore. If they do, look at the top card of the Vine's deck and put it on either the top or the bottom of its deck.

name: The Vine Maw
text:
Ward
MOMENT OF DREAD When the Vine plays this character, move its draw token up 1.
WALL OF THORNS Characters named Vine Tendril gain Bodyguard.
TRIUMPH When this character is banished, the Illumineers win the scenario and open The Heart of the Vine prize pack!

name: Yzma
text: ACCELERATED GROWTH When the Vine plays this character, it makes a Vine Tendril for each Illumineer.
flavor_text: Every bit as intimidating as the original.

name: Kronk
text:
GIVE ME A SEC This character enters play exerted.
THAT'S GOTTA HURT When the Vine plays this character, it deals 1 damage to each opposing character.
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one of the Vine's characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

name: Flynn Rider
text:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
TOUGH LOSS When the Vine plays this character, each Illumineer loses 2 lore.

name: Bramble Bully
text: TURN BACK When the Vine plays this character, banish all opposing characters with cost 3 or less.
flavor_text: A dry, whispering laugh fills the air. This is no mere vine sprout.

name: Vine Sprout
flavor_text:
"I've never seen a plant do that before! Do you think it knows any other tricks?"
—Tigger, Hunny Barbarian

name: Isabela Madrigal
text: PERFECTLY PROTECTED While the Vine has another exerted character in play, this character can't be challenged.
flavor_text: A bloom as flawless as any other the vine has created.

name: Sulley
text: TERRIFYING SURPRISE When the Vine plays this character, each Illumineer chooses and banishes one of their characters.
flavor_text: "Yikes! That vine-created copy could be Top Scarer!" —Mike Wazowski

name: Pete
text:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.) 
TIMEOUT When the Vine plays this character, each Illumineer chooses and returns one of their characters to their hand.

name: Cruella De Vil
text:
SO LAST SEASON Whenever this character quests, each Illumineer chooses and discards a card.
HIGH COST OF FASHION During the Illumineers' turn, they may together pay 6 {I} to banish this character.

name: Budding Stalk
text: ACCELERATED GROWTH When the Vine plays this character, it makes a Vine Tendril for each Illumineer.
flavor_text:
"It's going to take all of us working together to pull this weed!"
—Rabbit, Hunny Paladin

name: Rapunzel
text: THORNY LOCKS When the Vine plays this character, it deals 1 damage to the lowest cost character each Illumineer has in play. (If there's a tie, the Illumineer chooses from their tied characters.)

name: Vine Sprout
text: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
flavor_text: The high-pitched whine of their tiny wings buzzes in your ear.

name: Ming Lee
text:
BIG TARGET This character enters play exerted.
RASH DECISION When the Vine plays this character, all opposing characters gain Reckless until the start of the Vine's next turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
DIFFICULT CHOICE During the Illumineers' turn, they may choose and discard 2 cards total from their hands to ready this character.

name: Vine Cluster
text: BIG BITE When the Vine plays this character, it deals 3 damage to the highest cost character each Illumineer has in play. (If there's a tie, the Illumineer chooses from their tied characters.)

name: Vine Sprout
text: NEW GROWTH When the Vine plays this character, it makes a Vine Tendril.
flavor_text:
"What's that sparkly light, Mama? It's so pretty."
—Roo, Hunny Rogue

name: 4*Town
text: DISCORDANT NOISE The Illumineers can't play songs.
flavor_text: When they open their mouths, a horrible sound fills the air, drowning out everything else.

name: Vine Sprout
text:
Bodyguard (An opposing character who challenges one of the Vine's characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.) 
TAKING ROOT This character enters play exerted.

name: Accelerated Growth
text: The Vine makes a Vine Tendril for each Illumineer.
flavor_text: New tendrils make it even more difficult to find the way through the room. Perhaps a little magic will clear the path . . .

name: Overwhelm
text: The Vine puts the top 2 cards of its deck into its inkwell facedown. Then, if the Vine has 7 or more cards in its inkwell, it makes a Vine Tendril for each Illumineer.
flavor_text:
"I propose, my dear archmage, that we decamp post-haste."
—Owl, Hunny Ranger

name: Catastrophic Rupture
text: Banish all opposing characters and locations.
flavor_text: Colorful energy overwhelms you as mixed ink bursts from the vine.

name: Wild Growth
text: The Vine draws a card for each Illumineer.
flavor_text: A skittering noise fills the air as vinelings and a thicket of thorns surround you.

name: Tightening Grip
text: The Illumineers together choose a character of theirs and banish them. The Vine draws a card.
flavor_text:
"What a sticky predicament."
—Winnie the Pooh, Hunny Archmage

name: Uproot
text: The Vine banishes all opposing items and locations. If no items or locations were banished this way, the Vine draws a card.

name: Regenerate
text: The Vine plays the highest cost character from its discard for free. (If there's a tie, the Illumineers choose from the tied characters.)
flavor_text: There's something very strange about the way they regenerate.

name: Ink Vortex
text: The Vine banishes all opposing damaged characters.
flavor_text:
"I knew I should have learned how to swim. Probably wouldn't help, though."
—Eeyore, Hunny Scholar

name: Unseen Attack
text: The Vine deals 1 damage to each opposing character. If the Vine has a character named Vine Tendril in play, it gains 1 lore.
flavor_text: Before you know it, the vine lashes out in all directions with wicked thorns!

name: Overprune
text: Banish all characters named Vine Tendril.
flavor_text: The vine pulls back its tendrils, and you breathe a sigh of relief. Then the true scale of the plant becomes clear . . .

name: Cut Down
text: Each Illumineer chooses one of their characters and returns all their other characters to their hand. Each Illumineer loses 1 lore.
flavor_text:
"What rotten luck!"
—Tigger, Hunny Barbarian

name: Overgrown Defenses
text:
INTERTWINING Characters named Vine Tendril get +1 {S} and +1 {W}.
CUT BACK When the Illumineers complete an encounter, banish this item.

name: Sprouting Seed
text: NEW GROWTH {E} — The Vine makes a Vine Tendril.
flavor_text: Filled with an eerie light, the seed is already putting out roots, seeking more mixed ink.

name: Story Star Cage
text:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this item.)
FLOURISH {E} — The Vine draws a card.
BLIGHT During the Illumineers' turn, they may pay 3 lore each to banish this item.
